title: CarPro Flyby 30-50ML Car Glass Coating
description: This glass sealant utilises state-of-the-art technology developed specifically to maintain a strong coating on glass windscreen, which resists friction and abrasion by wipers, dust, car-wash or harsh cleansers. Further more it's fully rain repellent from 30mph and any speeds above this water will quickly fly off the glass allowing clearer vision and safer driving. CarPro FlyBy 30 Glass Sealant is also durable and the glass will remain water repellent for a minimum of 6~8 months(Based on ideal conditions and varies as per maintenance and usage), after this period it will remain water repellent but needs more speed to clear the glass. CarPro FlyBy 30 is very easy to use, with no haze, smears or staining of the glass with no wiper chatter.
Name: CarPro Flyby 30-50ML Car Glass Coating
